base_study._: H1-PA's frozen study record, read as it is: the arm, dataset, recipe, schedule, evaluation, storage and relay inputs of Mix-Augmented ARE D4-Augmented's (mixed_recovery_driver.load_plan copies the control arm and changes only its initialization); h1pa.json is never edited

initialization._: the MC1 Top-1, written by mixed_launch.read_back_top1 after the relay copy is downloaded and re-identified on the dev box; the pod stages it from the relay by sha256 and the driver re-identifies it again before training

control_recipe_sha256._: the recipe identity (h1pa_driver.recipe_identity: the derived config less where it runs) each D4-Augmented unit recorded in its report (artifacts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/h1pa/units/evidence/D4-Augmented-s<seed>/report/report.json :: inputs.recipe_sha256); a Mix-Augmented unit whose recipe hashes otherwise refuses before training

_durable: the units live under <am5m373kuq mount>/mixed_v2, beside H1-PA's <mount>/h1pa, which is never written
